description: SURFACED by the fz-rh2.17 close-out audit. Compiler2::submit_module_interface (compiler.rs:68) -> World::submit_module_interface (world.rs:382) -> Job::DefineModuleInterface publishes an 'external' (host-submitted, no fz source) ModuleInterface through the same uniform type/path as local/protocol/runtime modules. The MECHANISM is uniform and correct, but it has NO production caller outside tests (world_test.rs:32, port_resolve_test.rs:393) -- so the 'external' module kind is theoretically-uniform but not load-bearing today. RESOLVE: either exercise it from a real embedder/fixture (proving the fourth module kind works end-to-end), or document it as an intentionally test-only/embedder-facing API. Related: fz-rh2.17.
title: Compiler2::submit_module_interface (external-module interface entry) has no production caller -- exercise from a real embedder/fixture or document as test-only
